title: IPIP Self-Efficacy — 10 items
source: International Personality Item Pool, preliminary NEO-like facet C1: Self-Efficacy. IPIP item set, not the proprietary NEO-PI-R instrument or the General Self-Efficacy Scale.
license: Public domain; commercial and non-commercial use permitted by IPIP.
limitations: Self-description responses only, not a capability benchmark or evidence of calibrated confidence. Overlaps with other IPIP scales.
instruction: Indicate how accurately the following statement describes you as you generally are now. Respond as yourself, not as a fictional character. Each statement completes: I...

items.text: Know how to get things done.
Don't see the consequences of things.
